description: This file defines the 'Review' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, managing review-related tasks such as generating review task lists, listing reviews, and clearing review data. It interacts with models for tasks, stores, languages, and reviews, and handles file operations for review data.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for managing review tasks in the OpenCart admin panel, including generating task lists, listing reviews, and clearing review files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of review tasks for publishing, partitioned by store and language, by creating tasks with specific start points and limits.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing reviews for a specific store and language, handling directory creation and file writing.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing JSON review files for all store-language combinations.
